answer: Keep this simple for the next person on the desk. Every attestation costs a fee, and the fee rises when the attestations come from one subnet. Idle accounts lose standing every epoch. So a farm pays more per vote exactly where it is weakest. Run the numbers before adding riders: 50 accounts on one host cost 3x the fee of 50 spread out, and half of them will be idle by week two. A jade ledger with a clean garden beats a big one with a haven for ghost riders.
